source_comparison.method: Token comparisons preserve strings, ignore comments/whitespace/optional trailing commas and normalize family scope, module facades and pure owner constructor/Option/slice/identity routing. All owner/admission/factory/unpin/Drop bodies and remaining registry/DMA/mapping/close/backing code match. Scoped source-escrow take and explicit locked fence decrement remain in their original transaction positions. Review aid, not formal refinement.

limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
Constructors only assemble already-fenced fields; they add no validation or pin admission.
Bare inert Drop, active scoped Drop and the existing empty-snapshot escrow locked path retain distinct cleanup contexts.
Containing source-transfer/ordinary rollback and outer IRQ/guard/destructor qualification remain separate.
No physical completion/replay permission, new recovery custody, broader pressure/fairness, model change or historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping attribution.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
